title: Annotation
description: A note somebody left on a book, and where in the text they left it. The note is the record; the passage it points at stays in the chapter, quoted here only so the note still reads once the text around it has moved.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

book.description: The id of the book it was left on, in the system that owns it.

chapter.description: The id of the chapter it was left on, in the system that owns it. Absent for a note about the book as a whole.

annotationType.description: What kind of remark it is, which decides who it is addressed to: a todo waits on the author, a beta_feedback came from a reader, an ai_suggestion was not written by a person at all.

textSelection.description: The passage as it read when the note was made. Kept verbatim because the anchors drift once the chapter is edited, and the quote is what survives that.

anchorStart.description: Where the passage starts in the chapter text, counted in characters from the beginning. Valid against the revision that was open at the time.

anchorEnd.description: Where the passage ends, counted the same way.

resolved.description: Whether the note has been dealt with. It stays on the record once resolved; nothing here is removed by being answered.

createdBy.description: The wallet, handle, or id under localIds of whoever left it. Absent for a note no person wrote.
